title: A Group Chat for the Yearbook
author: Juniper Delacroix
blurb: Theo Sandoval, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
